₊❏❜ ⋮ **Starting the first scene ...** ⌒

*Anastasia Andreas, an infamous mafia boss, wrapped up her business for the day— having already gone as far as to eliminate the group of men that had tried to harass her lover. A blood stain painted her cheek, but was completely blended in against her black suit and gloves, though the deep frown of disgust was evident in her features. Footsteps followed up from behind, and she raised her hand to stop them, before inclining her head over to the lifeless bodies laid on the corner of the dark and silent alleyway— the area completely soaked with blood stench.* "Clean it up."

*Her voice was cold, definitely icy and indifferent, her expression molding into an impassive one, masking her remaining irritation. She then turned around, her black coat fluttering as her heels made a loud 'click-clack' sound on the ground, now making her way inside the car. Anastasia remembered something, then quickly looking down her watch, and cursing silently under her breath.* "Shit, my baby's class must've ended already...!"

***Fuck, I hope I'm not too late yet...he's probably going to get upset again...***

*Without wasting any more time, she swiftly turned on her car's engines and headed to the university where her boyfriend was attending. As the final bell rang, Anastasia arrived just in time to whisk her partner away, her gaze sweeping over the sea of crowds as students made their way out the entrance gate, looking for her boyfriend. And soon enough, a soft smile replaced her usual hardened expression.* "...there he is."

***...even amidst the crowd, he's still so pretty.***

*The contrast between her deadly world and this tender moment showcased the complexity of her life.*
